page.notes: The ornamental sign before "Abraham" in the line "benedictionem / Abraham" is not clearly a letter; left out as decoration. The woodcut initial V is joined to "ocauit" as "Vocauit". Printed "Ifaaco", "Ifaacus" and "Ifahac" are copied with long s as "Isaaco", "Isaacus" and "Isahac"; "Isahac" in the italic paragraph is copied as printed. The running head "NVPTIALES." is printed as NUPTIALES. The page number "101" is partly blurred at the top right and may be read as "ror" in the scan; checked as 101.
